source_text: Regarding promiscuity reduction, no causal evidence links FGM to lower infidelity rates in Sudan or comparable settings; cross-cultural studies indicate that sexual behavior is primarily regulated by social norms, religious edicts, and community enforcement rather than anatomical modification, as evidenced by low promiscuity in non-FGM-practicing societies with analogous cultural controls. [37]
